facts.text: Ingenuity Helicopter was deployed at Jezero Crater during Perseverance (Mars 2020) in 2021.

Ingenuity was the first aircraft to achieve powered, controlled flight on another planet. Weighing just 1.8 kg, it made 72 flights over nearly three years, far exceeding its planned five-flight technology demonstration. On 18 January 2024, it damaged a rotor blade during its 72nd flight and was retired. It proved that aerial exploration of Mars is possible.
Engineered specifically to operate in the harsh vacuum and extreme temperatures of the Martian environment.
Proved powered, controlled flight is possible in Mars's thin atmosphere (1% of Earth's), scouting terrain for Perseverance and photographing the surface from above.
Status: Remains preserved in the arid regolith at Jezero Crater.
Grounded at Valinor Hills since 18 January 2024 after blade damage on flight 72; it now serves as a stationary weather station while still communicating with Perseverance.
